title: The Lost Qasari Caravan
rumor: The Lost Qasari Caravan. An old caravan carrying precious stones, rare spices, and a sealed chest of unknown origin disappeared along a forgotten desert trade route generations ago. According to Qasari tradition, the merchants were not killed, but instead followed a false star into the wilderness. Occasionally, travelers report finding strange silver coins scattered along the route.
first_lead: Sahir Keshan has seen coins bearing the caravan master's distinctive mark.
